name: Lon Tengal
source: Lon is a Caro's childhood friend, who wants to become rich as soon as possible. He is lazy, rude, selfish, cowardly, and constantly running after women's skirts, but because of his unworthy behavior, all the girls are bumping him in the most rude way. However, Lon makes his feasible contribution to the fight with demons, and always encourages friends when they've lost their heart.
